items.author: ChartsBtc
items.context: ChartsBTC (bot de gráficos) publica el power law de hoy: precio $74.148, precio del modelo $145.537, «49.05% below trend», «736 days behind trend»; la fecha power law para el precio actual sería 2024-11-04.
items.suggested_text: Being 49% below the trend line sounds like a discount, but the model has spent long stretches far under that line before. The line is the center, not the floor, so I look at the corridor around it rather than the gap to one number. How I read it: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2118779927340470279

items.author: ELLIPAL
items.context: ELLIPAL (fabricante de hardware wallets), citando la noticia de BlackRock sobre la demanda de convertir bitcoin autocustodiado en acciones del ETF por seguridad: con un ETF un custodio guarda el bitcoin y tú tienes acciones; con una hardware wallet tú tienes las llaves y el respaldo es tu responsabilidad. «Pick the trade-off that fits you».
items.suggested_text: There's a third trade-off worth naming: with a commercial hardware wallet you hold the keys, but you still trust the vendor's firmware and how it generates them. You can remove that dependency too. I wrote a book on building your own air-gapped setup, free on Kindle until Wednesday: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: Adellbah
items.context: OXMallam resume el caso Coldcard: según su post, un error de compilación de marzo de 2021 debilitó la generación de semillas (≈40 bits en Mk2/Mk3, ≈72 bits en Mk4/Mk5/Q) y unos 1.816 BTC (~$116M) salieron de más de 5.200 direcciones; actualizar el firmware no basta, hay que crear una semilla nueva; las semillas hechas con al menos 50 tiradas de dados no se consideran vulnerables a esta falla.
items.suggested_text: The part that stuck with me is the exception: seeds made with enough fair dice rolls weren't exposed to this flaw. Entropy you generate and can check yourself beats entropy you have to trust a vendor for. That's the core of the air-gapped setup I describe here: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2119476332635586800

items.author: Crypto_Obrian
items.context: CryptO'brian hace el resumen del día: BTC cerca de $74,3K tras tocar $73,7K, salidas de ETF de ~$201M el lunes, ~$270M en liquidaciones (mayormente largos), MARA vendió 13.597 BTC, CPI de EE. UU. a las 8:30 ET; soportes $73,5K y resistencia $75,5K–$76K. Conclusión: el mercado necesita evidencia de que la demanda vuelve, no solo un rebote.
items.suggested_text: Agree that a bounce isn't the signal. A CPI candle tells you about one morning; flows tell you whether demand is actually back. I'd rather wait a few days of ETF data than read the first move after the print. Which flow number would change your mind first?
